You can't be controlled by something you actually notice.

Kevin explains that most people stop hearing the sounds around them: the trains, the planes, the sirens. His first step is to raise your awareness of what you hear.

When you notice something, you process it and decide whether to accept or reject it. That keeps you in charge of your own reactions.

What have you stopped noticing in your own life?
